items.title: 71542_Bill Coleman autobiographical manuscript
items.q: He was known as Rastus at that time and although the name is a drag, he was featured with Paul Whiteman's orchestra.

ctx.x: The job was not hard and especially with two bands. When we started work at 8.30. in the evening, the sun was still shining bright. And when we finished at 1.30.a.m. day would be breaking and the birds would be doing their thing.

Sad as the band was, another agent who was a woman who lived in Copenhagen got me 15 days at the Tivoli Karolinelund amusement park in Aalborg, Denmark and this job was very easy because it featured attractions only and one of the attractions was an American Negro named Freddie Crump who was the first drummer in the world that did a drum act. I had seen him when I was a teenager with Cooper's Black and White show, which I mentioned on an earlier page. I've seen and heard plenty of drummers since those days, but…
A few days before the end of the engagement I started to have a bad case of sciatica. I couldn't walk or stand. I went to work with a taxi and had to sit on the bandstand.
